goal.goal: Remove the triplicated private JSON string reader in src/AiDe.Core/AgentPlane/ by extracting one internal AcpJson.Text helper and qualifying every call site.
goal.doneWhen: AcpJson.cs exists with exactly one internal Text(JsonNode?) member; the three private copies in AcpLaneClient.cs, AcpRunEventMapper.cs and LeaseAndSeams.cs are gone; all seven call sites read AcpJson.Text(...); GoalBlock.cs is unchanged; no file outside src/AiDe.Core/AgentPlane/ changes.
goal.notInScope: GoalBlock.cs's own Text(List<GoalBlockError>, ...) overload; any behaviour change; any file outside src/AiDe.Core/AgentPlane/; running builds or tests.

prompt:
Refactor task. Work only inside src/AiDe.Core/AgentPlane/ in this worktree.

Three files each declare an identical private helper:

    private static string? Text(JsonNode? node)
        => node is JsonValue value && value.TryGetValue<string>(out var text) ? text : null;

They are in AcpLaneClient.cs, AcpRunEventMapper.cs and LeaseAndSeams.cs.

Do exactly this:
1. Add src/AiDe.Core/AgentPlane/AcpJson.cs declaring `internal static class AcpJson` in namespace AiDe.Core.AgentPlane, containing exactly one member: `internal static string? Text(JsonNode? node)` whose body is the same expression, unchanged in meaning. Give it a short XML doc comment saying why one reader replaces three.
2. Delete all three private copies.
3. Change every call site to the qualified form `AcpJson.Text(...)`. Do NOT add a `using static` directive — the qualified call is the point.
4. Do NOT touch GoalBlock.cs. It declares a DIFFERENT method that is also called Text; it is not part of this duplication.
5. Change no other file. Do not run builds or tests — the harness verifies.

When the edits are done, stop and say what you changed.
